review_text: You get just about none of the benefits of the AirPods Pro, but the fit is perfect, battery is awesome and sound is really good for open-ear.
Seamless with my iPhone and Mac, switching between devices is effortless. Wish they had ANC at this price though.
The sound was extremely bright in my ears, way too much emphasis from 8kHz up. Had to go into EQ settings and draw a severe curve.
One earbud stopped charging after 3 weeks. Apple store replaced them but the trip and hassle was annoying. No rubber tips so they slide out when I run.
Call quality is the best I have had on any earbuds, people say I sound like I am on the phone directly. Battery easily lasts a full work day.
Great if you are all-in on Apple. For the price, the lack of ear tips and weak bass isolation is hard to justify versus Soundcore.
They fit great and do not fall out. Battery life is long, I get 3 full charges from the case. Best $25 I ever spent on earbuds.
Bass is punchy and the app with 22 EQ presets is great. Only complaint: no volume controls on the earbuds themselves by default.
Some connectivity issues, audio drops for a second when I walk between rooms, and the touch controls need improvement.
Comfortable and stable fit, good at reducing office chatter. Struggles to block out bass range noise like the bus engine on my commute.
Right earbud died completely after two months. Support offered a partial refund instead of replacement, felt cheap even at this price.
IPX5 handles my sweaty workouts fine. Fast charge is a lifesaver, 10 minutes gives me 2 hours before the gym.
Amazing sound for the price, crisp highs and strong bass. Stayed in place through intense gym sessions with zero ear pain after hours.
Battery is a lifesaver, gets through a whole day of music and podcasts without reaching for a charger. IPX8 waterproofing survived a rainy run.
Touch controls are way too sensitive, pauses my music whenever I adjust them or even when warm water hits them in the shower.
Every time they reconnect the volume maxes out, nearly blew my eardrums. Also still uses outdated microUSB in 2026 which is unacceptable.
Great waterproofing and battery but the mic is only usable in quiet rooms, any wind or traffic kills your voice on calls.
The TOZO app EQ customization is surprisingly good for a budget brand. No ANC but the seal blocks enough for my commute.
